idea: a slow folk song about walking home by lantern light
title: Lantern Road
lyrics:
[Verse]
Lantern swinging, gravel road
Every window gold
[Chorus]
Carry me home

caption.global_metadata: Slow acoustic folk, 72 BPM, D major, warm and close.
caption.vocal_details: Soft male lead with a low harmony in the chorus.
caption.arrangement: Verse: fingerpicked guitar. Chorus: brushed drums and upright bass.
